title: Physically admissible QS1 manifold root-search and hydrological discriminator
purpose: Re-test the unchanged QS1 quasi-steady manifold with a root-search construction that approaches physical-domain boundaries from valid interior seeds rather than requiring invalid fixed endpoints.

seed_order: previous accepted q for this history/stage when available
prescribed_bottom_head.boundary_search: From each finite seed, approach each open domain boundary by repeated midpoint halving; invalid evaluations define a physical boundary and are never accepted as bracket endpoints.
prescribed_bottom_head.sign_rule: First pair of finite evaluations with opposite storage-residual signs brackets the root.
prescribed_bottom_head.invalid_midpoint: fail closed; do not jump across an invalid manifold interval

seed_order: previous accepted h_bottom for this history/stage when available
prescribed_bottom_flux.boundary_search: Approach the fixed open z-domain boundaries by repeated midpoint halving from finite seeds; invalid evaluations define a physical boundary.
prescribed_bottom_flux.sign_rule: First pair of finite evaluations with opposite storage-residual signs brackets the root.

checks: prescribed-head q-root finite for all three targets at h_bottom=h0
prescribed-flux h-root finite for all three targets at q_bottom=K(theta0)
reconstructed profiles remain in open physical domain
equilibrium root reproduces expected q/h branch without fixed-endpoint evaluation
preflight.failure_rule: If preflight fails, close D7 before any D01-D08 or V01-V04 trajectory evaluation.

trajectory_gate.scalar_update: single Heun predictor-corrector identical to D6

positive_rule: and balance view beats/equal R2 on total-storage and cumulative-bottom-exchange RMSE
or transient view beats/equal R2 on bottom-flux RMSE and sign-error count
